# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = ["fonttools>=4.53"]
# ///
"""Generate five 'No slop' emoji icon variations using Liatrio brand tokens.

Text is converted to outlines from the bundled Space Grotesk variable font so
the SVGs render identically without the font installed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from fontTools.misc.transform import Transform
from fontTools.pens.svgPathPen import SVGPathPen
from fontTools.pens.transformPen import TransformPen
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib.instancer import instantiateVariableFont

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FONT = ROOT / "skills/liatrio-brand-guidelines/assets/fonts/SpaceGrotesk-VariableFont_wght.ttf"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# Liatrio tokens (assets/colors_and_type.css)
DARK_BG = "#1A1F23"
DARK_BG_2 = "#1E2327"
WHITE = "#FFFFFF"
GREY_800 = "#111111"
GREY_400 = "#999999"
GREY_500 = "#666666"
PRIMARY_GREEN = "#24AE1D"
BRIGHT_GREEN = "#89DF00"
HOT_RED = "#E63946"

SIZE = 128
C = SIZE / 2

_instances: dict[int, tuple] = {}


def instance(weight: int):
    if weight not in _instances:
        font = instantiateVariableFont(TTFont(FONT), {"wght": weight}, inplace=False)
        upem = font["head"].unitsPerEm
        cap = font["OS/2"].sCapHeight
        _instances[weight] = (font, font.getGlyphSet(), font.getBestCmap(), font["hmtx"], upem, cap)
    return _instances[weight]


def text_path(text: str, size: float, weight: int, tracking: float = 0.0):
    """Return (path_d, advance_width, cap_height) with the baseline at y=0."""
    _, glyphset, cmap, hmtx, upem, cap = instance(weight)
    scale = size / upem
    parts: list[str] = []
    x = 0.0
    for ch in text:
        gname = cmap.get(ord(ch))
        if gname is None:
            continue
        spen = SVGPathPen(glyphset)
        glyphset[gname].draw(TransformPen(spen, Transform(scale, 0, 0, -scale, x, 0)))
        d = spen.getCommands()
        if d:
            parts.append(d)
        x += hmtx[gname][0] * scale + tracking
    width = x - tracking if text else 0.0
    return " ".join(parts), width, cap * scale


def centered_text(text, size, weight, fill, cy, tracking=0.0, cx=C, opacity=None):
    """Text block visually centered on cy (cap-height centering)."""
    d, w, cap = text_path(text, size, weight, tracking)
    x = cx - w / 2
    y = cy + cap / 2
    op = f' opacity="{opacity}"' if opacity is not None else ""
    return f'<path d="{d}" fill="{fill}" transform="translate({x:.2f} {y:.2f})"{op}/>'


def ring(color, r, w, cx=C, cy=C):
    return f'<circle cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" r="{r}" fill="none" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{w}"/>'


def slash(color, r, w, cx=C, cy=C):
    """Ghostbusters-style bar: upper-left to lower-right, meeting the ring."""
    k = r * 0.70710678
    return (
        f'<line x1="{cx - k:.2f}" y1="{cy - k:.2f}" x2="{cx + k:.2f}" y2="{cy + k:.2f}" '
        f'stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{w}" stroke-linecap="butt"/>'
    )


def svg(body: str, title: str, desc: str) -> str:
    return (
        f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {SIZE} {SIZE}" '
        f'width="{SIZE}" height="{SIZE}" role="img" aria-label="{title}">\n'
        f"  <title>{title}</title>\n  <desc>{desc}</desc>\n  {body}\n</svg>\n"
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variations
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def v1_classic_red() -> str:
    """Dark plate, hot-red prohibition ring and slash over stacked NO / SLOP."""
    r, w = 51.0, 11.0
    body = "\n  ".join([
        f'<rect width="{SIZE}" height="{SIZE}" rx="20" fill="{DARK_BG}"/>',
        ring(HOT_RED, r, w),
        centered_text("NO", 23, 500, WHITE, 48, tracking=1.6),
        centered_text("SLOP", 30, 700, WHITE, 78, tracking=-0.3),
        slash(HOT_RED, r, w),
    ])
    return svg(body, "No slop", "Hot-red prohibition ring and slash over the words NO SLOP on a dark Liatrio canvas.")


def v2_green_hero() -> str:
    """Square brand-CTA plate, primary-green ring and slash over one word."""
    r, w = 51.0, 12.0
    body = "\n  ".join([
        f'<rect width="{SIZE}" height="{SIZE}" fill="{DARK_BG}"/>',
        f'<rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="{SIZE - 1}" height="{SIZE - 1}" fill="none" stroke="#2A3036"/>',
        ring(PRIMARY_GREEN, r, w),
        centered_text("SLOP", 34, 700, WHITE, 64, tracking=-0.4),
        slash(PRIMARY_GREEN, r, w),
    ])
    return svg(body, "No slop", "Primary-green prohibition ring and slash over the word SLOP on a square dark Liatrio plate.")


def v3_bright_inverse() -> str:
    """Bright-green chip with the mark knocked out in graphite."""
    r, w = 51.0, 11.0
    body = "\n  ".join([
        f'<rect width="{SIZE}" height="{SIZE}" rx="20" fill="{BRIGHT_GREEN}"/>',
        ring(DARK_BG, r, w),
        centered_text("NO", 23, 500, DARK_BG, 48, tracking=1.6),
        centered_text("SLOP", 30, 700, DARK_BG, 78, tracking=-0.3),
        slash(DARK_BG, r, w),
    ])
    return svg(body, "No slop", "Graphite prohibition ring and slash over the words NO SLOP on a bright-green Liatrio chip.")


def v4_ghostbusters() -> str:
    """Closest homage: a grey goo blob inside the ring, slash over the blob."""
    r, w = 51.0, 10.0
    blob = (
        "M 50 8 C 72 8, 89 25, 89 47 C 89 57, 84 62, 85 69 "
        "C 86 78, 78 83, 72 77 C 71 86, 62 89, 57 82 "
        "C 55 91, 45 92, 42 83 C 38 90, 29 88, 29 78 "
        "C 23 84, 14 79, 16 70 C 17 62, 11 57, 11 47 "
        "C 11 25, 28 8, 50 8 Z"
    )
    body = "\n  ".join([
        f'<rect width="{SIZE}" height="{SIZE}" rx="20" fill="{DARK_BG}"/>',
        f'<g transform="translate(31.5 26) scale(0.65)">',
        f'  <path d="{blob}" fill="{GREY_400}"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="36" cy="38" r="8" fill="{GREY_500}"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="5.5" fill="{GREY_500}"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="43" cy="63" r="4" fill="{GREY_500}"/>',
        "</g>",
        ring(HOT_RED, r, w),
        slash(HOT_RED, r, w),
        f'<rect x="16" y="94" width="96" height="22" fill="{DARK_BG_2}"/>',
        centered_text("NO SLOP", 15, 700, WHITE, 105, tracking=1.2),
    ])
    return svg(body, "No slop", "Ghostbusters-style grey goo blob crossed out by a hot-red ring and slash, labelled NO SLOP.")


def v5_transparent_mono() -> str:
    """No plate: one-color hot-red mark that survives light and dark themes."""
    r, w = 51.0, 11.0
    body = "\n  ".join([
        ring(HOT_RED, r, w),
        centered_text("NO", 23, 500, HOT_RED, 48, tracking=1.6),
        centered_text("SLOP", 30, 700, HOT_RED, 78, tracking=-0.3),
        slash(HOT_RED, r, w),
    ])
    return svg(body, "No slop", "Single-color hot-red prohibition ring and slash over the words NO SLOP on a transparent background.")


VARIATIONS = [
    ("01-classic-red", v1_classic_red, "Classic red"),
    ("02-green-hero", v2_green_hero, "Green hero"),
    ("03-bright-inverse", v3_bright_inverse, "Bright inverse"),
    ("04-ghostbusters-goo", v4_ghostbusters, "Ghostbusters goo"),
    ("05-transparent-mono", v5_transparent_mono, "Transparent mono"),
]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Contrast verification
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def luminance(hexcolor: str) -> float:
    h = hexcolor.lstrip("#")
    parts = []
    for i in (0, 2, 4):
        c = int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255
        parts.append(c / 12.92 if c <= 0.03928 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4)
    return 0.2126 * parts[0] + 0.7152 * parts[1] + 0.0722 * parts[2]


def ratio(a: str, b: str) -> float:
    la, lb = luminance(a), luminance(b)
    hi, lo = max(la, lb), min(la, lb)
    return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05)


def main() -> None:
    svg_dir = OUT / "svg"
    png_dir = OUT / "png"
    for name, fn, _ in VARIATIONS:
        path = svg_dir / f"{name}.svg"
        path.write_text(fn(), encoding="utf-8")
        for px in (128, 512):
            subprocess.run(
                ["rsvg-convert", "-w", str(px), "-h", str(px), "-o", str(png_dir / f"{name}-{px}.png"), str(path)],
                check=True,
            )
        print(f"built {name}")

    print("\ncontrast checks (WCAG):")
    checks = [
        ("white text / dark canvas", WHITE, DARK_BG),
        ("hot red ring / dark canvas", HOT_RED, DARK_BG),
        ("primary green ring / dark canvas", PRIMARY_GREEN, DARK_BG),
        ("dark mark / bright green chip", DARK_BG, BRIGHT_GREEN),
        ("grey blob / dark canvas", GREY_400, DARK_BG),
        ("hot red mark / white (light theme)", HOT_RED, "#FFFFFF"),
        ("hot red mark / dark (dark theme)", HOT_RED, DARK_BG),
    ]
    for label, fg, bg in checks:
        print(f"  {ratio(fg, bg):5.2f}:1  {label}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Animation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The two animated plates share a silhouette. Variation 2 ships square, but a
# corner that pops in and out every cycle reads as a glitch, so the GIF frames
# both use variation 1's 20px radius.
GIF_RADIUS = 20
HOLD_CS = 80          # centiseconds each plate holds
FADE_STEPS = 6
FADE_CS = 3           # ~180ms total, inside the brand's 200ms state-change budget


def ease(t: float, x1=0.22, y1=1.0, x2=0.36, y2=1.0) -> float:
    """Liatrio's default cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), solved for y at x=t."""
    def axis(a: float, b: float, u: float) -> float:
        return 3 * a * u * (1 - u) ** 2 + 3 * b * u ** 2 * (1 - u) + u ** 3

    lo, hi = 0.0, 1.0
    for _ in range(24):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if axis(x1, x2, mid) < t:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return axis(y1, y2, (lo + hi) / 2)


def _render(markup: str, stem: Path, px: int = SIZE) -> Path:
    svg_file = stem.with_suffix(".svg")
    png_file = stem.with_suffix(".png")
    svg_file.write_text(markup, encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(
        ["rsvg-convert", "-w", str(px), "-h", str(px), "-o", str(png_file), str(svg_file)],
        check=True,
    )
    svg_file.unlink()
    return png_file


def _blend(base: Path, overlay: Path, pct: float, out: Path) -> Path:
    subprocess.run(
        ["magick", str(base), str(overlay), "-alpha", "on", "-compose", "blend",
         "-define", f"compose:args={pct:.1f}", "-composite", str(out)],
        check=True,
    )
    return out


def _assemble(frames: list[tuple[Path, int]], out: Path) -> None:
    cmd = ["magick", "-loop", "0", "-dispose", "Background"]
    for path, delay in frames:
        cmd += ["-delay", str(delay), str(path)]
    cmd += ["-layers", "OptimizeTransparency", str(out)]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)


def build_gifs(work: Path, gif_dir: Path) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    a = _render(v1_classic_red(radius=GIF_RADIUS), work / "frame-a")
    b = _render(v2_green_hero(radius=GIF_RADIUS), work / "frame-b")

    cut = gif_dir / "ai-slop-cut.gif"
    _assemble([(a, HOLD_CS), (b, HOLD_CS)], cut)

    frames: list[tuple[Path, int]] = [(a, HOLD_CS)]
    for i in range(1, FADE_STEPS):
        frames.append((_blend(a, b, ease(i / FADE_STEPS) * 100, work / f"ab{i}.png"), FADE_CS))
    frames.append((b, HOLD_CS))
    for i in range(1, FADE_STEPS):
        frames.append((_blend(b, a, ease(i / FADE_STEPS) * 100, work / f"ba{i}.png"), FADE_CS))
    fade = gif_dir / "ai-slop-fade.gif"
    _assemble(frames, fade)

    return [(g.name, g.stat().st_size) for g in (cut, fade)]

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = ["fonttools>=4.53"]

"""Scratch: find the largest wordmark that still clears the ring and the slash."""

import math
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).parent))
from build import C, text_path  # noqa: E402

INNER_R = 52.0 - 12.0 / 2      # ring centerline minus half stroke
BAR_HALF = (12.0 + 3.0) / 2    # slash plus its keyline
DIAG_CLEAR = BAR_HALF * math.sqrt(2)


def corners(text, size, tracking, cy):
    _, w, cap = text_path(text, size, 700, tracking)
    x0, x1 = C - w / 2, C + w / 2
    y0, y1 = cy - cap / 2, cy + cap / 2
    return [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x0, y1), (x1, y1)], w, cap


def in_ring(pts):
    return all(math.hypot(x - C, y - C) <= INNER_R for x, y in pts)


def clears_slash(pts):
    return all(abs(x - y) > DIAG_CLEAR for x, y in pts)


print(f"inner radius {INNER_R}, slash clearance {DIAG_CLEAR:.2f}\n")

print("SLOP — largest size per cap-center y (ring fit only; slash may cross it):")
for cy in (74, 78, 80, 82, 84, 86):
    best = max((s for s in [x / 2 for x in range(40, 90)]
                if in_ring(corners("SLOP", s, -0.3, cy)[0])), default=None)
    print(f"  cy={cy}: max size {best}")

print("\nAI — largest size per cap-center y (must clear ring AND slash):")
for cy in (32, 34, 36, 38, 40):
    ok = [s for s in [x / 2 for x in range(30, 70)]

# AI Slop emoji designs

Slack emoji icons reading **AI SLOP** under a Ghostbusters-style ring-and-slash,
built to Liatrio brand tokens. Everything in this folder is generated by a single
script, so the SVGs, PNGs, GIFs, and the preview page are all reproducible.

## Requirements

| Tool | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) | Runs `build.py`; dependencies are declared inline (PEP 723) |
| `rsvg-convert` (librsvg) | Rasterizing SVG to PNG |
| `magick` (ImageMagick 7) | Assembling the animated GIFs |

## Build

```bash
uv run build.py
```

This regenerates `svg/`, `png/`, `gif/`, and `preview.html`. The script also
reports two checks on every run: whether any wordmark overruns its ring
containment budget, and the WCAG contrast ratio of each color pairing.

## Preview

`preview.html` is a contact sheet of every variation at 22px, 32px, 48px, and
128px on both light and dark backgrounds, with a sidebar for toggling
individual cards. It needs to be served rather than opened from disk, because
the font loads over HTTP:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Then open <http://127.0.0.1:8765/preview.html>.

## Layout

```text
build.py              Single source of truth for every asset
assets/fonts/         Space Grotesk variable font (SIL OFL 1.1)
svg/                  Five static variations, 128x128
png/                  The same five at 128px and 512px
gif/                  Animated variations, all under Slack's 128KB cap
preview.html          Generated contact sheet
```

## Current picks

The animated finalists are the "long clear beat" fades, where the ring and
slash fade out, the wordmark holds alone for 0.45s, and the mark fades back in
the other brand color:

- `gif/ai-slop-fade-hold-xl-match.gif` — AI and SLOP set at the same cap height
- `gif/ai-slop-fade-hold-xl-plus.gif` — AI overshoots SLOP by 12 percent, which
  pays back the fact that it is the shorter word and reads better at 22px

## Notes

Text is converted to outlines from the bundled font, so the SVGs render
identically anywhere without Space Grotesk installed. Type in the fade
variations is deliberately larger than the ring interior would normally allow:
it may pass behind the ring stroke, but `build.py` enforces that no glyph
crosses the stroke's outer edge.
